title: An Empirical Evaluation of GDPR Compliance Violations in Android mHealth Apps
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is to empirically evaluate the compliance of mobile health applications with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). GDPR is a legal framework founded on ethical principles concerning data privacy, user consent, and data security. The study directly assesses the adherence of software to these established ethical and legal standards, making it an evaluation of ethical conduct in the context of data handling and privacy.
